outcome.Summary: Created the `tmpl` package (tmpl/tmpl.go + tmpl/tmpl_test.go) implementing Render per spec: verbatim text outside `{{ }}`, `{{{{` → literal `{{`, tag parsing with whitespace-insensitive names/filters, quoted args with `\"`/`\\` escapes, nested `map[string]any` field resolution, value formatting (string/int/int64/float64/bool, nil/missing → ""), and the upper/lower/trim/default/truncate/html filters with rune-based truncation and U+2026. All listed error cases (unknown filter, missing/extra args, bad truncate arg, unterminated/empty tag, bad name, non-map indexing with full name in the message) return an error with empty output. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` — all 44 subtests pass, exit 0.
